review_kind: Source/model and manuscript correspondence review; not external human peer review.
authorship_scope: Reviewer authored the two-coordinate all-input chain, selected information bridge and helper robust wrapper; independently reviewed the global inverse model, distribution endpoint, degree consequence and verification guards.
scope: Boolean packets depending on at most two declared stored coordinates, with empty, unary, constant and repeated occurrences permitted.
Exact all-input row-recoding distance inequality and unchanged bounded-degree and path/cycle constants; explicit adapters retain the original XOR special case.
Global full-cube bijective bank, explicit inverse row dependence, original raw row side information, and correctness only on the observed promised input family.
Arbitrary normalized finite input law and noninjective sample observation; actual helper entropy and expected branch length/near-coordinate count.
The distribution and helper endpoints derive the entropy and positive-mass fiber bounds from actual code hypotheses; no assumed fiber inequality remains.
Bounded inverse width and reuse derive the degree consequence with its stated explicit constant.
proof_checks: Component counting uses connected-graph edge counting and finite pigeonhole collisions; the collision cube argument does not assume XOR linearity.
The selected total-correlation bridge conditions on the full broadcast through an exact equal-fiber argument; demand-view fixes reconcile equal finite views without new hypotheses.
Positive-mass helper fibers have normalized weights and the correct restricted raw range; zero-mass fibers vanish under averaging.
The degree proof enlarges its coefficient only after proving aggregate deficit nonnegative, and invokes the actual helper theorem at every chosen radius.

validation.focused_axiom_audits: Central all-input and adapter declarations, both information/demand bridges, and both helper-wrapper declarations used only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
validation.statement_headers: Printed central distance, degree, helper and demand-factor headers match the reviewed scope.
validation.full_publication_verification: Recorded separately by verify.py and completion_check.py; this report does not substitute for their current run.

manuscript_comparison.reviewed_sections: Two-coordinate all-input statements and the new correlated-input/helper/global-recoding model, theorem, outline and degree corollary in local-coding.tex.
manuscript_comparison.result: No stronger English conclusion or hidden full-support, independence, injectivity, extra side-information or runtime premise found.
corrections_applied: The definition now explicitly requires equal or adjacent stored rows for every two-coordinate support.
Formal annotations now use robust_broadcast_bound and degree_expected_length_lower_bound.
